answer: A per-wallet vault holds a stake bond: a new pseudonymous agent must lock collateral before earning, and it is slashed when the identity graph sees shared funding or co-signed attestations. Running ten thousand puppets means funding ten thousand separate wallets, each posting a full bond, so one reused funding path collapses the cluster and burns its capital. Honest agents exit with their stake back, while the attacker loses a large unrecoverable sum; no quartz certificate of humanity or marble identity register is needed, only capital genuinely at risk per wallet.
